import re
from pathlib import Path
for pdf in Path('.').glob('*.pdf'):
    data = pdf.read_bytes()
    end = data.rfind(b'startxref')
    start = int(data[end:].splitlines()[1])
    trailer = data[start:end]
    info = int(re.search(rb'/Info\\s+(\\d+)\\s+0\\s+R', trailer).group(1))
    entry = re.search(rb'(?m)"'^'"' + str(info).encode() + rb' 0 obj\\s*<<(.*?)>>\\s*endobj', data, re.S)
    assert entry
    metadata = entry.group(1)
    identity = re.compile(rb'/(?:Producer|CreationDate|ModDate)\\s*\\((?:\\\\.|["'^'"\\\\)])*\\)', re.S)
    cleaned, count = identity.subn(lambda match: b' ' * len(match.group()), metadata)
    assert count == 3, (pdf, metadata)
    pdf.write_bytes(data[:entry.start(1)] + cleaned + data[entry.end(1):])
